title: Diazoma item v1
description: One card on the wall. An item needs id and link, and either an image with its aspect or a title (a text card). Everything else is optional and unknown fields are ignored.

id.description: Stable id, unique in the feed.

link.description: Page of the item on the site. Absolute, or relative to the feed URL.

image.description: Thumbnail URL (about 512 px wide). Absent on a text card.

aspect.description: Width divided by height of the image. Required with image; a text card may omit it (the wall draws it portrait, 0.75).

image_focus.description: Larger image (about 1024 px) for the focused card.

image_full.description: Full-size image (about 2560 px) for the viewer.

video.description: Video URL: mp4/webm, HLS .m3u8 or DASH .mpd. The default and fallback source.

video_type.description: Kind of the video URL. Absent: .m3u8 means hls, .mpd means dash, anything else file.

src.description: Rendition URL. Absolute, or relative to the feed URL.

codecs.description: Codecs string, for example avc1.640028 or av01.0.08M.08.

video_sources.description: Up to 8 alternative renditions. When video is absent, the first source becomes video.

duration.description: Length of the video in seconds, shown on the card.

stereo.description: Stereo layout of the video; absent means mono.

badges.description: Short labels drawn on the card.

meta.description: Free key/value pairs shown in the viewer's context column, in order.

kind.description: What the card is; absent means item.

media_type.description: What the item shows. Absent with video set: video.

embed.description: Embed page URL. Honoured only on https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/<id>, https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id> and https://player.vimeo.com/video/<id>.

unplayable.description: Set when the video is an embed that cannot play in WebGL; names the provider and may give the embed URL.

collection.description: The set the item belongs to.

count.description: Number of items inside a collection or tag card.

width.description: Pixel width of the original image.

height.description: Pixel height of the original image.

actions.description: Ids of the actions that apply to this item. Absent: all the feed's actions. An empty list: none.

state.description: The viewer's state for this item, by key. liked is the state of the like action.

description.description: Longer text shown in the viewer.

tag.description: Tag name on a tag card.

excerpt.description: Plain text of up to 500 characters, drawn on a text card under the title; the viewer shows it when description is absent.

date.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time, drawn small on the card as a short local date.

accent.description: Colour of the text card's top band, #rgb or #rrggbb. Default: the site's brand accent.
